value.name: 69' · Walid El Karti v Al Ahly
value.competition: CAF Champions League 2017 final, second leg
value.narrative: Achraf Bencharki: sends a cross into the Ahly box. Walid El Karti: heads it in from close range past Sherif Ekramy.
value.reconstructionScope: Final documented contacts; not the entire possession.

goals.notes: Both: 69th minute, Bencharki cross, El Karti header, 1-0 on the night and 2-1 aggregate. Africanews adds the cross was deflected while FIFA calls it precise; that quality detail was dropped. Neither gives the flank, so zone C2 is a coarse anchor only.

value.name: 15' · Zouhair El Moutaraji v Al Ahly
value.narrative: Aymane El Hassouni: lays the ball to El Moutaraji after an Ahly giveaway. Zouhair El Moutaraji: strikes a powerful right-footed shot from outside the box into the top-left corner.

sequence.note: Lay-off to El Moutaraji after Ahly lost the ball.
Powerful long-range strike into the top-left corner.

value.reconstructionScope: Final documented contacts; not the entire possession.
value.spatialPolicy: Regions are coarse diagram anchors for the positions described in the sources. No measured coordinates, complete build-up, unspecified flank or exact distance is claimed. goals.notes: BusinessDay: Yasser Ibrahim's stray pass reached Hassouni, who passed to El Moutaraji; swerving drive into the top-left corner. Soccer Laduma: Hassouni laid it off; powerful right-foot effort from outside the box into the top-left corner. BusinessDay's 'out to the wing' detail is not confirmed and was dropped. AFP (World Soccer Talk) also confirms 15th minute and a shot from outside the area.

value.name: 48' · Zouhair El Moutaraji v Al Ahly
value.narrative: Zouhair El Moutaraji: gets ahead of his marker and directs a close-range effort at goal. Mohamed El Shenawy: parries it. Zouhair El Moutaraji: drives the rebound home.

sequence.note: First effort on goal after a cross from the right.

value.reconstructionScope: Final documented contacts; not the entire possession.
value.spatialPolicy: Regions are coarse diagram anchors for the positions described in the sources. No measured coordinates, complete build-up, unspecified flank or exact distance is claimed. Reconstructions may begin with the final contiguous two to five contacts; omitted upstream contacts are outside the replay scope.

goals.notes: Ahram Online and SuperSport: three minutes into the second half (SuperSport 48'), El Moutaraji beats Mohamed Hany to a cross from the right, El Shenawy saves/spills, El Moutaraji scores the rebound. AFP also confirms save then rebound. The crosser is NOT recorded: Ahram names Aymane El Hassouni with a low cross from the right, while BusinessDay says Jalal Daoudi chipped it from the left; that conflict was dropped and the sequence starts at the shot.

value.narrative: Bouly Sambou: plays the ball on to Bouhra inside the area. Saifeddine Bouhra: lashes a powerful shot into the net.

sequence.note: Powerful finish, four minutes after coming on.

goals.notes: SuperSport: 86', substitute Bouhra (on 82'), assisted by Junior Sambou, shot from inside the area into the top-left corner. Sports World Ghana: 86', Sambou redirected an Ayoub El Amloud cut-back and Bouhra fired a powerful shot. El Amloud's cut-back is single-source and was left out of the sequence; corner placement is SuperSport only.

value.competition: CAF Champions League 2023 semi-final, second leg
value.narrative: Yahya Jabrane: delivers the ball into the box from the left. Ayoub El Amloud: arrives late and heads it in.

sequence.note: Right-back arrives late and heads home.

goals.notes: SuperSport: 72', Jabrane pin-point diagonal ball from the left, El Amloud arrives late and heads home. Sports World Ghana: 72', well-timed header from Jabrane's cross. The Citizen says the equaliser came from a corner, so whether it was open play or a set piece is not claimed. Flank (left) is SuperSport only.

value.name: 25' · Thembinkosi Lorch v Juventus
value.competition: FIFA Club World Cup 2025, group stage
value.narrative: Nordin Amrabat: wins the ball and slips Lorch in behind the defence. Thembinkosi Lorch: takes a touch and lobs the onrushing Michele Di Gregorio.

sequence.note: Ball played into Lorch's path behind the defence.
One touch, then a lob over the advancing goalkeeper.

goals.notes: TimesLIVE: 25', Amrabat through ball behind the defence, Lorch touch then lob. Juventus.com: 25', Juve lost the ball from a throw-in, Amrabat won it and fed Lorch, who lofted it over Di Gregorio. Soccer Laduma also confirms Amrabat played Lorch in and a one-touch-then-lob finish. Pitch locations are not given.
